app.name: Cloud Music
app.description: Connect your own storage and enjoy your music anywhere.
account.guestHelp: Your guest identity is saved in this browser and removed after 30 days of inactivity. Signing out or clearing browser data makes it unrecoverable. Set a password to keep your account.
account.usernameHelp: 3–32 ASCII letters, digits or underscores. Usernames are case-insensitive.
account.passwordHelp: Use 8–1024 UTF-8 bytes. Some characters, including Chinese, use more than one byte.
account.guestSwitchHelp: You are using a guest account. Set a password to keep its data. Logging in to another account or registering separately will not merge your guest data.
account.switchConfirm: I understand that this switches accounts and does not merge my guest data into the destination account.
account.manageOrLogout: Manage your account or log out
home.heading: Your music, wherever you go
home.description: Connect your own storage and build your personal music library.
home.comingSoon: Your library and player are under construction.
login.title: Log in · Cloud Music
login.description: Log in to continue to your personal music space.
register.title: Create an account · Cloud Music
register.description: Choose a username and password. You can change your display name at any time.
settings.title: Settings · Cloud Music
settings.description: Manage your profile, password and login sessions.
settings.guestHelp: Guest accounts are removed after 30 days of inactivity. Set a password to keep your identity and data.
settings.personalHelp: Your personal data belongs to this account. Changing your username or display name does not change your account identity.
settings.usernameHelp: 3–32 ASCII letters, digits or underscores. Use the new username to log in after changing it.
settings.displayHelp: Up to 100 characters. You may leave this empty.
settings.upgradeHeading: Set a password to upgrade your account
settings.upgradeHelp: Choose a username and password to become a registered user while keeping your identity and data. Existing accounts cannot be merged.
settings.passwordHelp: Changing your password logs out all devices. You will need to log in again.
settings.upgradeNameHelp: 3–32 ASCII letters, digits or underscores. The username must be unique.
settings.newPasswordHelp: Use 8–1024 UTF-8 bytes. Some characters use more than one byte.
settings.upgraded: Your account has been upgraded. Your guest identity and data have been kept.
settings.guestStorage: Set a password and upgrade your account before connecting external storage.
settings.memberStorage: Your account has a password. Storage connections will be available in a future release.
settings.logoutGuestConfirm: Logging out makes this guest identity and its data unrecoverable. Consider setting a password first. Are you sure you want to log out?
settings.logoutAllConfirm: Log out all devices, including this one?
session.retryHelp: Your identity could not be verified. Local credentials have been kept. Restore your connection and try again.
session.storageWrite: Your browser cannot save your identity. Allow this site to store data; you may need to log in again after closing the page.
session.storageRead: Your browser cannot read your identity. Allow this site to store data.
session.expiredGuest: Your session has expired or been logged out. Please log in again. An expired guest identity cannot be recovered.
session.expired: Your session has expired or been logged out. Please log in again.
session.changedElsewhere: Your identity changed in another page. Please try again.
session.loginRequired: Log in or continue as a guest first.
session.changed: Your identity has changed. Please check the current account.
session.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed and all devices have been logged out. Log in with your new password.
session.loggedOutAll: All devices have been logged out.
session.loggedOut: You have logged out of this session.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait one minute and try again.
error.usernameTaken: This username is taken. Please choose another one.
error.unauthorized: Authentication failed. Check your password or log in again.
error.invalid: Some information is invalid. Check your input and try again.
error.server: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
error.network: Cannot connect to the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
error.displayName: Display names may contain up to 100 characters and cannot include a null character.
pwa.label: App update
pwa.ready: A new version is ready. Refresh to use it.
pwa.interrupt: Refreshing interrupts playback. You can update later.
pwa.failed: Update failed. Please try again later.
